fact: The Ministry of Health's annual performance report for 2021, dated December 2022, states that the absence of an information system allowing data collection at the first line made its diabetes and hypertension indicator hard to calculate; it names the ministry's Centre informatique as the public operator for the information system, with 17 of 57 regional and university hospital sites' local networks upgraded in 2021.
title: Rapport annuel de performance de l'année 2021
publisher: République Tunisienne, Ministère de la santé, Unité GBO
